patthana19.8:1.1: pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. na bhāvanāya pahātabbadhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.8:2.1: na nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā. (saṃkhittaṃ.)
